# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue.** Anonchat is an end-to-end encrypted
messaging tool — security disclosures must be private.

Send details to the maintainer via a private channel listed on the
repository owner's profile. Include:

- A clear description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce
- Affected versions
- Any proof-of-concept or exploit code (if available)

You will receive a response within 72 hours. Once the issue is
triaged, we will agree on a disclosure timeline and coordinate a
fix release.

## Supported Versions

| Version  | Supported          |
| -------- | ------------------ |
| latest   | :white_check_mark: |
| < latest | :x:                |

Only the latest tagged release receives security patches.

## Design

See [`docs/SECURITY.md`](../docs/SECURITY.md) for the full
cryptographic architecture, threat model, and design trade-offs.
